verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਸਕਾਰਥੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pair sakaarathe gurmukh maarag chaal chala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Blessed are the feet of the Sikhs who walk in Guru's way;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਚਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: guroo dhuaarai jaan chal saadhasa(n)gat chal jai baha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Who go to the Gurudwara and sit their in the holy congregation;

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਨੋ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhaavan paraupakaar no gursikhaa no khoj laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Who search out the Guru's Sikhs and hasten to do them favours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਧਾਵਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhubidhaa pa(n)th na dhaavanee maiaa vich udhaas raha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Worthy are the feet of the Sikh's who do not go on the way of duality and possessing wealth remain indifferent to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ba(n)dh khalaasee ba(n)dhagee virale keiee hukamee ba(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Few are the people who abide by the orders of the Supreme Commander, do Him homage and thus escape from their bonds;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਪਰਦਖਣਾਂ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhaa paradhakhanaa(n) pairee pai raharaas kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Who adopt the custom of circumambulating the Guru's Sikhs and falling at their feet.
The Guru's Sikhs delight in such enjoyments.
